messages.subject: Re: R packages installation error
parts:
I have tried to install R-Studio from beginning: Some times the "raster" package cannot be installed. In this case, you need to do as follows

1. Install Rtools from this file

https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/rtools42/files/rtools42-5355-5357.exe

2. Install "terra" and "raster" package (as shown in the attached figure):
With RStudio click "Install => type "terra" in the "Packages" text box.
Do similar for installing the "raster"package
